faqs.q: Can AI tell which emails need a reply?
faqs.a: Yes. The AI agent reads each unread email and decides whether it needs a reply, a read, a wait or nothing. Tell it to put anything it is unsure about under read, so nothing slips past you.

faqs.q: Will it send emails for me?
faqs.a: Not without your yes. AI agents ask before sending, even to you, until you allow it in Settings. Each reply waits in Needs you.

faqs.q: Does it answer the moment an email arrives?
faqs.a: No. It runs on a schedule, here every weekday at 8:00, or when you ask it in its chat. It is a morning pass over your unread mail, not an instant responder.

faqs.q: How does it learn how I write?
faqs.a: From its instructions and your corrections. Tell its chat what to change, such as shorter replies or a different sign-off, and later drafts follow it.

faqs.q: Is this the same as AI for support email?
faqs.a: No. A support queue is one address with questions to answer. This reads your own mixed inbox, where most mail is not a question and the job is deciding what needs you.
